info.description:
One gateway (dispatch-go) serves every endpoint; `/v1/agents/*`, `/v1/pricing/*` and the Safety Sentinel's `/v1/safety/*` endpoints are proxied to agents-py (marked `x-served-by: agents-py`).

**Auth.** Create a key with `POST /v1/developer/keys` and send it as `Authorization: Bearer hxg_…` (or `X-API-Key`, or `?api_key=` on WebSockets). Each operation lists the scope it needs in `x-required-scope`. Keyed requests are rate limited per key (token bucket, 60/min by default) and answer with `X-RateLimit-*` headers. Requests without a key are the first-party path (the HexaGo apps and internal services); a keyless browser request from an origin outside the CORS allow-list gets 401.

Money is in integer paise (1 INR = 100 paise) on the ledger and in rupees on quotes.

Upgrade to a WebSocket, then send `{"action":"subscribe","topics":["ride:<id>"]}` (schema StreamControl). Frames are `{"topic","data"}` (schema StreamFrame), batched once per second: `drivers` (positions), `ride:<id>` (status, driver position, ETA), `ops` (agent events and metrics). Browsers cannot set headers on WebSockets, so pass the key as `?api_key=hxg_…`.
